verdict.rationale: No evidence pack item directly documents injecting dynamic variables or per-caller context into a call at dispatch time. The evidence only shows adjacent capabilities: Memory recalls people across conversations so interactions feel personalized, pathways and custom API tools can call webhooks or HTTP endpoints mid-call to fetch data, and batch calls take a per-recipient CSV. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of call-time variable injection (e.g., request data or template variables in prompts), per-caller variables in batch CSVs, and any hands-on or independent confirmation.
